messages:
Mira (Product): Shared a new compact mock for the Audit Log export modal. Please do a quick UX + security + a11y pass before we freeze labels.
Sam (Design): quick read: liking the tighter layout. micro nit: the UI label 'Presets' isn't clear. suggest 'Saved views' or 'Filters' to improve discoverability.
Matt (Eng): heads up: current CSV headers are timestamp,event_type,actor,resource,region,retention_days. Changing visible labels will break downstream parsers. We can emit a companion export_manifest.json with header_aliases to map UI labels to CSV headers.
Elaine (Security): requirement: if the export includes any KMS key IDs or aliases, show this warning: "Export contains key metadata. Confirm export destination meets your org's export controls and retention policy." Also log an audit event when user opts in.
Aria (A11y): a11y checklist: 1) filter chips need role=button and aria-pressed; 2) saved-views menu must support arrow-key navigation and a visible focus ring; 3) announce "Export started" and progress updates via aria-live=polite.
Sam (Design): visual nit: the tiny KMS lock badge (12px purple) tooltip fails contrast. Options: add inline 'KMS' label, increase badge size, or use a high-contrast tooltip. I prefer inline label for clarity.
Mira (Product): decision: rename to 'Saved views', add inline KMS label, and wire manifest approach. Also change UI retention label to 'Retention period' while backend maps to retention_days.
Matt (Eng): plan: emit export_manifest.json with export_version, headers, header_aliases. Add opt-in checkbox 'Include key metadata' default OFF. Gate typed confirmation for enterprise orgs: user must type "I understand" to proceed. ETA: EOW for review.
Elaine (Security): +1 on typed confirm for enterprise. Add link to export guidance doc and record opt-ins in audit logs.
Aria (A11y): modal must trap focus, initial focus on the typed input, and the confirm input should have aria-describedby linking to the warning text. Validation errors must be announced.
opsbot: deploy-preview ready: http://preview/redwood/audit-export-ux (auto)
Mira (Product): owners: Matt (backend), Sam (copy/visuals), Aria (a11y sign-off), Elaine (security). I'll draft the PR checklist and ship copy tweaks tomorrow unless objections.
